newsitem.title: POLAND: Southern Polish municipalities seek bond issue.
newsitem.headline: Southern Polish municipalities seek bond issue.

text.p: The seven municipalities in the southern Polish Katowice province preparing to issue municipal bonds signed a preliminary agreement with Fundusz Gornoslaski to organise and manage the issues, a daily said.
The Nowa Europa business daily said on Monday the first issue could take place in about six months.
Fundusz Gornoslaski is a regional modernisation and restructuring fund, about 80-percent owned by the treasury.
The seven municipalities are Dabrowa Gornicza, Jastrzebie, Ruda Slaska, Sosnowiec, Tarnowskie Gory, Tychy and Zory.
